fullDescription: Enterprise SSO sign-in screen on deep navy with a single amber accent: a SOC 2 trust badge, a primary 'Continue with SSO' button, Google/SAML fallbacks and an email field, all in one centered glass card over a soft amber-glow ambient background. Inter, single-accent navy + amber.
prompt:
## Resumo
A full-bleed enterprise SSO sign-in screen for a fictional product, 'Aperture', on a deep navy canvas. A sticky translucent nav spans the top, a single centered auth card holds the whole login flow, and a minimal footer closes the page. The card leads with a primary amber 'Continue with SSO' button, falls back to Google + SAML providers, then to an email field, and is wrapped by an enterprise-trust frame: a 'SOC 2 Type II · Enterprise SSO' badge above and an end-to-end-encryption reassurance note below. The whole thing floats over a calm ambient background (a soft amber glow blob, a navy blob and a faint grid veil).

## Estilo Visual
Design a premium enterprise dark auth aesthetic. Background: solid deep navy #0b1f3a (darker navy #081730 for nav/footer, mid navy #102a4d / #16365f for fills). Text in warm cream #f4ecd8 (soft #e8ddc4), secondary/muted copy in slate-blue #a9b4c4 (cream-dim). Use exactly ONE accent, amber #f0b429 (dark hover #d99c1c), for the primary button, the trust badge, links and focus rings. Build an ambient background layer (pointer-events-none, absolute inset-0): a large soft amber glow blob (h/w ~480px, bg amber at 10% alpha, blur 120px) top-center, a navy glow blob (~360px, navy-600 at 40% alpha, blur 100px) bottom-right, and a faint 48px grid veil (linear-gradient white 1px lines, opacity ~0.04). Surfaces are glass: bg rgba(255,255,255,0.03), 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.10) border, rounded-2xl, shadow-2xl shadow-black/50, backdrop-blur-sm, with a top accent hairline (gradient transparent->amber/60->transparent). Font: 'Inter' everywhere (400/500/600/700/800), tight tracking on headings; antialiased; smooth scroll. Focus state on inputs = amber border + 3px amber ring at 25% alpha. Keep it calm, high-contrast and enterprise-trustworthy: one accent, lots of breathing room, soft shadows.

## Layout e Estrutura

### Sticky nav
Sticky top nav (top-0, z-50), full width, 1px bottom border white/5, bg navy-900 at 80% alpha with backdrop-blur-md. Inner row: max-w-6xl, items-center, justify-between, px-6 py-4. Left = logo lockup: an 8x8 rounded-lg amber tile with a navy 'ph:diamonds-four-fill' glyph + an 'Aperture' wordmark (Inter 700, ~15px, cream). Right = a row (gap-6, text-sm): 'Docs' and 'Status' ghost links (cream/70, hover cream, hidden on mobile) + a 'Contact sales' outline button (rounded-lg, 1px white/15 border, cream text, hover amber border + amber text).

### Hero / auth main
main is relative, flex, min-h-[calc(100vh-65px)], items-center justify-center, overflow-hidden, px-6 py-16. Behind it an ambient background layer (pointer-events-none absolute inset-0): top-center amber glow blob, bottom-right navy glow blob, and a faint 48px white grid veil at ~4% opacity. The content is a relative z-10 column, w-full, max-w-[420px], centered.

### Heading block
Centered, mb-7. A pill trust badge: inline-flex, rounded-full, 1px amber/30 border, bg amber/10, px-3 py-1, 11px uppercase semibold tracked amber text, with a leading 'ph:shield-check-fill' icon, reading 'SOC 2 Type II · Enterprise SSO'. Below it an h1 'Sign in to Aperture' (Inter 800, ~32px, leading-tight, tight tracking, cream). Then a small subtitle in cream-dim: 'Use your organization's single sign-on to continue.'

### Auth card
A glass card: relative, overflow-hidden, rounded-2xl, 1px white/10 border, bg white/[0.03], p-7, shadow-2xl shadow-black/50, backdrop-blur-sm, with a top accent hairline (absolute inset-x-0 top-0 h-px, gradient transparent->amber/60->transparent). Contents, top to bottom: (1) PRIMARY SSO button, full-width, rounded-xl, bg amber, navy-900 text, 15px semibold, shadow-lg shadow-amber/20, a top inner white/20->transparent gloss overlay, a 'ph:buildings-fill' icon + 'Continue with SSO', hover bg amber-dark. (2) An 'or' divider (two white/10 hairlines flanking an uppercase tracked cream-dim label). (3) Two secondary provider buttons stacked (space-y-2.5), each full-width rounded-xl, 1px white/12 border, bg white/[0.04], cream text, hover border white/25 + bg white/[0.07]: 'Continue with Google' (flat-color-icons:google) and 'Continue with SAML' (ph:lock-key-fill). (4) An 'or use email' divider. (5) A form: one email field built as a .field-glow shell (flex items-center gap-2.5, rounded-xl, 1px white/12 border, bg navy-900/60, leading 'ph:envelope-simple' icon, transparent input 'you@company.com', focus-within = amber border + 3px amber/25 ring) + a full-width outline 'Continue with email' button (rounded-xl, 1px white/15 border, transparent bg, cream text, hover bg white/[0.06]).

### Security note + footer link
Below the card (mt-4): a reassurance note row, rounded-xl, 1px white/8 border, bg white/[0.02], px-4 py-3, xs cream-dim text, with a leading amber 'ph:lock-simple-fill' icon: 'Connections are encrypted end to end and we never store your SSO credentials.' + a 'Read our security overview' underline link. Then (mt-7) a centered footer line in cream-dim: 'New to Aperture?' + an amber 'Request access' link (hover amber-dark).

### Footer
Full-bleed footer on solid navy-900, 1px top border white/5. Inner row: max-w-6xl, px-6 py-6, xs cream-dim, flex-col on mobile -> sm:flex-row, items-center, justify-between, gap-3. Left = '© 2026 Aperture, Inc.'; right = a gap-5 row of 'Terms' / 'Privacy' / 'Security' text links (hover cream).

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Componente
Enterprise trust badge: a small amber pill ('SOC 2 Type II · Enterprise SSO') with a shield-check icon, sitting above the title to signal compliance.

### Componente
Primary SSO button: full-width amber button with a navy label, an inner top gloss highlight and an amber-tinted drop shadow, leading the auth hierarchy as the recommended path.

### Componente
Provider fallback stack: a vertical Google + SAML set of glass buttons under an 'or' divider, with brand/lock icons.

### Componente
Glowing email field: a .field-glow input shell whose focus-within state paints an amber border and a 3px amber focus ring (25% alpha).

### Componente
Security reassurance note: a bordered glass strip with a lock icon explaining end-to-end encryption + a 'Read our security overview' link.

### Componente
Layered ambient background: a soft amber glow blob + a navy glow blob + a faint 48px grid veil, composited as one pointer-events-none layer behind the card.

### Componente
Glassmorphic auth card with a top amber accent hairline (gradient transparent->amber->transparent).

### Componente
Translucent sticky nav with backdrop blur, an amber logo tile and a 'Contact sales' outline CTA.

## Notas Especiais
Color tokens (exact): navy DEFAULT/800 #0b1f3a, navy-900 #081730, navy-700 #102a4d, navy-600 #16365f; cream DEFAULT #f4ecd8, cream-soft #e8ddc4, cream-dim #a9b4c4; amber DEFAULT #f0b429, amber-dark #d99c1c. Single-accent system: amber is the ONLY accent (CTA, badge, links, focus). Font: 'Inter' everywhere (weights 400/500/600/700/800) via Google Fonts. Built on Tailwind (CDN) with a custom theme (navy/cream/amber scales) and one custom class, .field-glow (focus-within amber border + 3px amber/25 ring). Icons via Iconify (phosphor 'ph:*' set + 'flat-color-icons:google'). Auth hierarchy is intentional: SSO primary, Google/SAML secondary, email last, matching an enterprise login flow. Fully responsive: the narrow 420px card recenters on all widths; nav 'Docs'/'Status' links and the footer row collapse on mobile. color-scheme implied dark, antialiased, smooth scroll.

style.description: Confident, enterprise-grade dark UI built on a navy + cream + single-amber-accent system. A deep navy canvas (#0b1f3a) with cream text (#f4ecd8) and a muted slate-blue for secondary copy (#a9b4c4). Amber (#f0b429) is the only accent, reserved for the primary CTA, the trust badge, links and focus states. Surfaces are subtle translucent glass (white at 3-4% alpha over the navy) with hairline white borders. Inter throughout (400-800). Generous rounded corners (cards ~16px, buttons/inputs ~12px), soft deep shadows, and an amber focus glow give it a premium, trustworthy feel without noise.
